_readme: Sample lines for the PDF-vs-Flutter Indic rendering spike.
Both renderers read THIS file — tool/spike/pdf_indic_spike.dart (Dart `pdf`
holds its own copy of the strings, so 'the same string renders differently'
is a fact about the file, not a claim about my copy-paste.
Every line is a real sentence a teacher could plausibly read, and every one
was chosen because it contains at least one feature that CANNOT be rendered
by mapping codepoints to glyphs in order. A row of isolated vowels would
pass in any renderer and prove nothing. `probes` names what each line is

samples.text: The teacher gave the students a difficult question.
probes: control: no shaping required, proves the harness itself renders text

samples.text: शिक्षक ने विद्यार्थियों को कठिन प्रश्न दिए।
probes: i-matra reordering: शि is stored श+ि but must DRAW ि to the LEFT of श; same in कठिन and दिए
conjunct ligature क्ष (क+्+ष) in शिक्षक
half-form द्य in विद्यार्थियों
reph र्थ: the ra rides ABOVE the following consonant, not beside it
half-form प्र and श्न in प्रश्न

samples.text: मराठी विद्यार्थ्यांची शाळा उद्या सुरू होईल.
probes: three-deep stack र्थ्यां: reph + half-tha + ya + matra + anusvara, the densest cluster in the set
half-form द्य in उद्या
ठी / ची / शा matra attachment
i-matra reordering: শি and বি and ণি draw ি to the LEFT
e-matra reordering: শ্রে draws ে to the LEFT of the whole cluster
conjunct ক্ষ, a true ligature with no resemblance to ক or ষ
conjunct শ্র (ra-phala, a hook below), দ্য, র্থ (reph), প্র, শ্ন
SPLIT vowel கொ: the single codepoint ொ must be drawn as TWO marks, one before க and one after it
pre-base vowel கே: ே precedes க visually but follows it in memory
ligature க்கு / த்தா: consonant + virama + u forms a single fused glyph, not three marks
below-base conjuncts (vattu) ధ్యా, ద్యా, ప్ర, శ్న, చ్చా: the second consonant shrinks and hangs UNDER the first
ర్థు reph-equivalent
matras that sit above the headline while a vattu sits below it
conjunct ಕ್ಷ, and below-base ದ್ಯಾ / ಪ್ರ / ಶ್ನೆ
ರ್ಥಿ: repha in Kannada attaches after, not above — a different rule from Devanagari
ಗೆ / ಕೇ vowel signs that reshape the consonant's own outline
SPLIT vowels ചോ and ളോ: ോ is one codepoint drawn as two marks straddling the consonant
chillu letters ൻ and ർ: standalone dead consonants, distinct glyphs
stacked conjunct ത്ഥ and ധ്യ / ദ്യ / ച്ചു
i-matra reordering: શિ and વિ draw િ to the LEFT
conjunct ક્ષ, half-forms દ્યા / પ્ર / શ્ન
reph ર્થી riding above the following consonant

samples.text: ਅਧਿਆਪਕ ਨੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਵਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ।
probes: sihari reordering: ਧਿ ਵਿ ਦਿ ਛਿ all store the vowel AFTER the consonant and must draw it BEFORE
addak ੱ (gemination mark) stacked above in ਪੁੱਛਿਆ
ੂੰ: dulainkar below plus tippi above on the same base
vowel sign ି in ଶି / ବି must fuse into the cluster, not sit after the consonant as a free-standing stroke
conjunct କ୍ଷ, below-base ଦ୍ୟା / ପ୍ର / ଶ୍ନ
below-base ଙ୍କୁ: nga + ka + u fused under one headstroke
reph ର୍ଥୀ
